explanation: Exchanging business cards is acceptable and often expected in Saudi business settings, though sources differ on how essential it is: one calls cards optional, another says they are very important. Present and receive cards with the right hand, and ideally print an Arabic translation on one side.
local_tip: Offer your card right-handed with the Arabic side facing the recipient, and take a moment to read any card you receive before placing it on the table rather than pocketing it immediately.

also_check.note: Cards are exchanged formally with both hands and reviewed carefully; titles and rank matter.
Card etiquette is more casual and closer to Western norms, with less ceremony.
Highly ritualized two-handed exchange with a bow; treating a card casually can offend.
